name: ca-residency-leaving-california
description: Leaving California for Texas, Florida, Nevada or abroad, tax year 2026. Who is a California resident under R&TC 17014 and Regulation 17014, domicile versus residence, the closest-connection test, the nine-month presumption (R&TC 17016) and the six-month visitor rule, the 546-day employment-contract safe harbor with its 45-day and $200,000 limits, the change-of-residence date, how Form 540NR taxes a part-year year (California tax rate times California taxable income, prorated exemption credits), which California-source income (real estate, installment sales, wages for work in California, partnerships, non-competes) stays taxable after the move, the qualified retirement income exclusion (R&TC 17952.5 and 4 U.S.C. 114), and the records that decide a residency audit. Trigger on "leaving California", "moving out of California taxes", "California residency audit", "part-year resident California", "540NR", "546 day rule", "California domicile".
